results.summary: REQ-023 to REQ-034 traced to named symbols and, for REQ-029 and REQ-035-adjacent behaviour, to ADR-005 and ADR-006; both decisions state the contract the code has. REQ-035 to REQ-051 remain.
AC-030 to AC-042 read against the lanes and fixtures they name; the typed columns exist with the coverage the cells state. AC-038 stays the one stale cell.

noveltyJustification: No new finding. Twelve requirements and two decisions were traced to the code that implements them, so the honest ratio is zero.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Traceability pass over twelve requirements, two decisions and three closure documents.
